asset_heavy.reason: Asset-light manager earning fees; the real estate is owned by the managed REITs and private funds, not RMR.

big_ticket.reason: Sells ongoing management contracts for REITs and funds; fees are recurring rather than large one-off purchases.

cyclical_demand.reason: Management fees from REITs and funds under ongoing contracts are not easily cut in downturns, though fees track asset values.

large_customers.reason: Clients are publicly traded REITs and institutional investors in separate accounts, joint ventures and funds.

notes: Based on the website text and general knowledge of RMR as manager of Seritage-type and affiliated REITs (e.g., Diversified Healthcare, Office Properties, Service Properties); fee revenue is the main source.

offers_products.reason: Offers management services and investment strategies; no manufactured goods or software. Funds are investment vehicles, not products sold.

offers_services.reason: Property management, asset management, leasing, engineering and development services for REITs and private investors.

people_delivered.reason: Fees pay for the skill and time of its real estate managers, leasing and engineering staff.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing management fees from long-term contracts with managed REITs and private capital vehicles.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Clients are REITs and institutional investors; no individual households are direct buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Manages REITs, separate accounts, joint ventures and funds for institutional investors and public companies.
